'''2011 Worlds Day 2 John Veasey DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''No tienes que correr / 60 ves & motor / Con Sido'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]]
* '''Username:''' Veez
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
